questions.prompt: According to the World Health Organization, health means…

questions.explain: Mental and social wellbeing matter too.

questions.prompt: In the sorter, why is scurvy non-communicable?
options: It's caused by a lack of vitamin C, not by a germ
questions.explain: Deficiency diseases can't spread between people.

questions.prompt: Which help prevent diseases spread by mosquitoes? Choose all that apply.
options: Emptying water from coolers, pots and tyres
questions.explain: Boiling water prevents water-borne diseases, not mosquito-borne ones.

questions.prompt: Dengue cases in many Indian cities rise sharply after the monsoon. Use your knowledge of how dengue spreads to explain why.
questions.modelAnswer: Dengue is caused by a virus carried by Aedes mosquitoes. Mosquitoes lay their eggs in still water, and their larvae and pupae develop in it. After the monsoon, rainwater collects in pots, tyres, coolers and drains, so many more mosquitoes breed. More mosquitoes biting infected and healthy people means the virus spreads faster.
rubric: Monsoon leaves stagnant water → more mosquitoes → more cases
questions.explain: Criterion C: explain a pattern in data with science.

questions.text: A microorganism that causes disease is called a ___.
questions.explain: Bacteria, viruses, fungi and protozoa can all be pathogens.
